subject.title: [Android] camera.snap missing, location.get not implemented, canvas.present broken on v2026.6.11

question: Should follow-up preserve the current gateway.nodes.allowCommands and node-approval gates while investigating Android advertising/A2UI readiness, or intentionally change camera/location command authorization?
rationale: Camera and location expose sensitive device data, and current source shows both command implementations and authorization gates; automation should not broaden exposure from this report alone.

options.title: Verify and preserve gates
options.body: Run current-main Android proof and fix only reproduced advertising, reapproval, settings, or A2UI readiness defects while keeping camera.snap and camera.clip explicit opt-in.

options.title: Change exposure policy
options.body: Intentionally broaden Android camera or location exposure only with security/product approval, docs updates, and upgrade proof.

options.title: Split after repro
options.body: If live proof shows independent causes, split camera, location, and A2UI into separate owner-reviewed issues or PRs.

recommendation.title: Verify and preserve gates
recommendation.body: Run current-main Android proof and fix only reproduced advertising, reapproval, settings, or A2UI readiness defects while keeping camera.snap and camera.clip explicit opt-in.

likelyOwner.reason: CONTRIBUTING.md lists obviyus for Android app ownership, and the decision centers on Android behavior plus sensitive node capability exposure.
